findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url_as_markdown · Private data: read_url_as_markdown · Public sink: compare_gas_costs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url_as_markdown · Private data: read_url_as_markdown · Public sink: compare_gas_costs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
